nodes.label: EventBus<T>
nodes.rationale: Static typed bus for economy, lives and level results.

nodes.label: GameController (Playing/Won/Lost state machine)
nodes.rationale: Split into partial files per concern.

nodes.label: MainFlow
nodes.rationale: Runs Home and Game as states of one scene.

nodes.label: PoolService
nodes.rationale: Balls, tubes and effects are pooled, warmed from the item registry.

nodes.label: PopupService
nodes.rationale: Instantiates each popup once and queues the rest.

nodes.label: Boosters (Undo, Extra Tube, Free Move)
nodes.rationale: Each booster is introduced with a one-time card and a hand tutorial.

nodes.label: Boot.unity scene
nodes.rationale: The game always starts from Boot.

nodes.label: Campaign (100 levels x 5 variants)
nodes.rationale: A retry plays the next layout variant; every board is checked solvable.

nodes.label: Custom shaders (orb, tube glass, ice, shell, transition)
nodes.norm_label: custom shaders (orb, tube glass, ice, shell, transition)

nodes.label: Fail Flow (rescue search)
nodes.rationale: A rescue search decides whether Undo or Continue can still save the board, so offers are only made when they can help.

nodes.label: Live Ops (daily reward streak, Orbit Rush)
nodes.norm_label: live ops (daily reward streak, orbit rush)

nodes.label: Obstacles (hidden orbs, frozen tubes, shutters/key orbs, bombs)
nodes.norm_label: obstacles (hidden orbs, frozen tubes, shutters/key orbs, bombs)

nodes.label: Opening Chain (levels 1-10)
nodes.rationale: Levels 1-10 run back to back with a side swipe and no menu, to keep early onboarding uninterrupted.

nodes.label: Store (bundles, coin packs, No Ads)
nodes.rationale: Purchases and ads are local stand-ins in this build.

nodes.label: One-way dependencies Contexts -> Common -> Core
nodes.rationale: Each layer is its own assembly and dependencies only flow downward.

nodes.label: Rules First (Unity-free rule classes)
nodes.rationale: Rule classes hold no Unity state so they can be covered by EditMode tests.

nodes.label: Explicit Service Registry
nodes.rationale: Filled once by the Bootstrapper; no hidden singletons.

nodes.label: Solvability Check (DFS solver with seen-set)
nodes.rationale: A depth-first solver with a seen-set proves a board can be won and reports when it cannot.
